scientific_integrity: The family and its alpha invariant are from Wu. Toric mld and canonical/terminal criteria are standard; only the specific sharp family classification and boundary consequence are new claims. Numerical checks are supporting tests, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: The mld is global over all centers, not closed-point mld; no classification of all local valuations or independent validation. Priority may overlap a differently named toric-singularity computation.
title: Sharp global discrepancies and the maximal-alpha boundary in a toric Fano realization family
